static_traits.name: Han Ning
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, keeping a koi named 'Spot'
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends to talk with, but finds it hard to discuss failure and self-doubt with them; interpersonal relationships affected
static_traits.medical_history: Never had similar psychological issues; never received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Neutral tone; clear expression, fairly coherent logic; able to describe trigger situations and automatic thoughts; good cooperativeness

basic_info.main_problem: Because a plant in the garden died, I feel I am a complete failure, and I have thoughts of giving up the new hobby of gardening.
basic_info.core_demands: This plant incident made me realize that feelings of failure and self-doubt are affecting my overall physical and mental health, so I seek counseling. I hope to explore how to stop these negative thoughts from taking dominance when things go wrong.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough at anything

special_situations.event: A plant dying in the garden
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot even keep a plant alive, it means I cannot do anything well/I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries positive self-talk and seeks comfort from friends; considers giving up gardening to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a complete failure; I should give up this hobby

special_situations.event: When making mistakes at work or facing setbacks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make mistakes at work, it means my ability is insufficient, and I will fail at more important things in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeking reassurance from friends, engaging in positive self-talk to ease unease
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I fail at such a small thing, I will inevitably fail at more important things too

special_situations.event: Not being able to sing/play the right notes during music practice
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Making mistakes in practice proves I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Relieves frustration through self-comfort and seeking comfort from friends

special_situations.event: Corrects mistakes at work and receives others' praise
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Even if there is success, it is just luck and does not represent my ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Denying positive outcomes, attributing success to luck to maintain a consistent self-evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is not my ability, just luck; the achievement does not count

core_conflict.wish: Craves recognition and being seen as capable
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure, fearing being negated as 'not good enough'
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being negated by denying positive outcomes or attributing them to luck
Maintaining self-doubt and seeking comfort from others to ease anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: An incompetent self, prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: Others are judges / people who may be disappointed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others praise their work or when facts show good performance (e.g. being praised after correcting mistakes)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Praise is not real, just luck; success does not represent ability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying or denying positive feedback, using self-deprecating phrasing like 'just luck', keeping a reserved tone, avoiding accepting praise

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When setbacks occur such as a plant dying, work mistakes or practice errors
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treats a partial failure as a total failure, viewing oneself or the situation as 'all bad'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using extreme conclusions (e.g. 'I am just a failure'), an absolutist tone, negating further attempts

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to adopt a more objective explanation or encouraged to do reality testing
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing reasonable explanations as 'making excuses', insisting on logical defense to maintain one's original view
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Leans toward discussing 'reasons' and 'theories', reduces emotional expression, emphasizing their own explanations in a calm, rational tone

manifestations: Questioning one's own value and ability in work, music and hobbies because a plant died
Interprets local setbacks as total failure, finding it hard to gain a sense of meaning from successful experiences
outcomes: Low mood and Sense of frustration

manifestations: Living alone, with only a few friends to talk to
Finding it hard to express failure and self-doubt to friends
outcomes: Relationships affected, support hard to fully obtain
More reliant on self-denial and seeking external comfort

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-denial ('I am a complete failure')
Deprecating oneself when successful, attributing it to luck
Excessively cautious about mistakes and magnifies their impact

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Finding it hard to discuss failure and self-doubt with friends
Turning needs that could be expressed outward into self-blame and negation

exception_events.target_problem: When setbacks occur at work or in other situations, the client usually catastrophizes and completely negates, leading to affected work performance and interpersonal tension
exception_events.unique_outcome: In one work instance, the client corrected a mistake and received praise, performing more effectively than before, and the result received positive feedback
exception_events.reason: Clues: different actions — actively correcting mistakes and completing tasks; different support — receiving positive feedback from others; different understanding — viewing mistakes as specific fixable problems.

positive_force: Has professional competence, able to discover and correct errors in work
Has a certain degree of social support (a few close friends)
Keeps interest in music and gardening, willing to try new things
negative_force: Catastrophizing and all-or-nothing thinking patterns, prone to generalizing partial setbacks into overall failure
Negating positive outcomes, attributing success to luck, finding it hard to internalize into confidence
Excessive self-doubt and seeking external comfort, difficulty with self-affirmation
Stress affects sleep and eating, lowering functioning level

target_behavior.behavior: Strong self-denial and giving-up tendencies after setbacks
antecedent: A plant dying in the garden
Going off-key or making mistakes during music practice
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking lead to viewing local mistakes as total failure; seeking external validation while ignoring one's own ability
target_behavior.function: Escaping the anxiety and shame brought by failure; briefly easing discomfort through others' comfort
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance, affected interpersonal relationships; disrupted sleep and eating; thoughts of giving up gardening

target_behavior.behavior: Disqualifying positive feedback and attributing success to luck
antecedent: Receiving others' praise after correcting mistakes
Completing tasks or achieving milestone results
target_behavior.core_reason: Maintaining the core belief of 'I am a failure' and attribution bias, avoiding cognitive dissonance
target_behavior.function: Maintaining a familiar self-concept to reduce uncertainty and anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty boosting self-confidence, successful experiences cannot be consolidated, persistent self-doubt
